title: 비영리민간단체 지원법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20170726:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rule of the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Decree No. 1, Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (12) Omitted.

(13) The Enforcement Rule of the Assistance for Non-Profit, Non-Governmental Organizations Act is partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (4), Article 3 (2) and (3), the first and second sentences of Article 4 (1), and Article 4 (2) 6, "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" is replaced in each instance with "Minister of the Interior and Safety".

In the first sentence of Article 4 (1), "Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs" is replaced with "Ministry of the Interior and Safety".

(14) through (64) Omitted.
